findings.highlight: ThenI should go even if there’s nothing I can do
findings.evidenceJa: なら何が出来なくとも、行かないと
findings.governingReading: Then, even if there is nothing I can do, I have to go
findings.explanation: A missing boundary visibly mangles Shirou’s statement of obligation.

findings.evidenceJa: ああもうなにやってんだ俺は
findings.governingReading: Damn it, what am I doing?
findings.explanation: A missing boundary produces malformed dialogue in Shirou’s self-rebuke.

findings.highlight: I run, ignoring all hesitation and fear
findings.evidenceJa: 迷いと恐れを断ち切って走り出す
findings.governingReading: I cut through my hesitation and fear and start running
findings.explanation: An active effort to sever hesitation and fear becomes passive disregard.

findings.highlight: suppress my trembling body with force and obstinacy
findings.evidenceJa: 見栄とか意地とかで押さえつけて
findings.governingReading: hold my trembling back in check with appearances and stubborn pride
findings.explanation: Shirou’s mixed, self-conscious motives become an unexplained external force plus obstinacy.

findings.highlight: She must have been hiding behind a tree
findings.evidenceJa: 木の陰に隠れていたのか
findings.governingReading: Apparently she had been hiding behind a tree
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative observation of Rin’s position is promoted into certainty.

findings.governingReading: supreme in both spirit and skill
findings.explanation: Rin’s precise reluctant praise of Saber’s mentality and technique becomes generic all-around greatness.

findings.highlight: Saber should be able to beat Berserker
findings.evidenceJa: このまま邪魔が入らなければ
findings.governingReading: If no one interferes, Saber will drive Berserker off
findings.explanation: The condition on Rin’s prediction is omitted, damaging the setup for Archer’s imminent intervention.

findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーに肉薄する
findings.explanation: Saber’s approach through the debris becomes an attack that has not yet occurred.

findings.highlight: I could not believe I was in this Holy Grail War thing
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争なんて言われても実感は湧かなかった
findings.governingReading: The Holy Grail War had not felt real to me
findings.explanation: mirror moon labels the source page9 text as a second page8, creating a duplicate page8 and eliminating page9 from the English script structure.

findings.highlight: a divine work of utmost excellence
findings.evidenceJa: これ以上はないという神業
findings.governingReading: a feat of skill beyond compare
findings.explanation: An idiom for consummate, superhuman technique becomes unnatural praise of a “divine work.”

findings.evidenceJa: 触れれば一瞬にして肉塊にされる旋風
findings.governingReading: a whirlwind that would reduce anyone it touched to a lump of flesh in an instant
findings.explanation: The concrete bodily stakes disappear into abstract “fatal destruction.”

findings.governingReading: fight all the way through even against a demon god
findings.explanation: Enduring the battle to its end becomes merely matching the opponent.

findings.highlight: she blocked Berserker’s sword on purpose
findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーの剣を受けたのはワザと
findings.governingReading: she deliberately took Berserker’s sword blow
findings.explanation: Rin’s tactical reinterpretation of accepting the blow becomes an intentional block.

findings.highlight: when we were walking down the hill
findings.evidenceJa: 坂道を歩いている時点で
findings.governingReading: by the time we were walking along the slope
findings.explanation: The English inserts a downward direction not stated in Shirou’s reconstruction of Saber’s planning.

findings.highlight: Saber’s sword must have hit Berserker, or Berserker must have lost his footing
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの剣がバーサーカーに届いたのか、それとも足場を失ったのか
findings.governingReading: whether Saber’s sword reached Berserker or he lost his footing
findings.explanation: Shirou’s unresolved visual alternatives are each phrased as necessities.

findings.evidenceJa: 苦し紛れに薙ぎ払われる旋風
findings.governingReading: A desperate sweeping blow comes howling across
findings.explanation: The narration inserts “beast” as a direct label where the source describes the attack as a whirlwind.

findings.highlight: holds her sword with both hands
findings.governingReading: resets her sword in a two-handed stance
findings.explanation: The deliberate reset of Saber’s stance becomes a static hold.
Shirou’s body moving before conscious narration becomes deliberate generalized action.
